abstract: Thirty-one patients were treated with cisplatin combination chemotherapy for advanced seminoma (26 Stage III or bulky Stage II testicular, and five disseminated extragonadal). Seventeen (89%) of 19 patients not previously pretreated and four (80%) of five who had received only abdominal irradiation entered continuous complete remission (CR), versus only two (28%) of seven patients who had received extensive infra- and supradiaphragmatic radiotherapy. Results were not significantly influenced by stage, human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) titers and histologic subgroups, whereas patients with lactic dehydrogenase (LDH) values exceeding 500 mIU/ml did worse (50% continuous CR rate in 12 cases) than those with normal or less elevated titers (89% continuous CR rate in 19 cases). After a median follow-up period of 34 months (range, 12+ to 77+ months), 23 patients (74.5%) remain alive in continuous CR, two (6%) died in CR and another one (3%) entered CR after deferred treatment of residual disease. Five patients (16%) died of cancer. Toxicity was severe in extensively irradiated patients, but it was acceptable in those not pretreated and in those who had received only subdiaphragmatic radiotherapy. Cisplatin combination chemotherapy can be successfully and safely used as the primary treatment of choice in patients with advanced seminoma. It is also an excellent salvage therapy for patients who had received subdiaphragmatic irradiation only. On the contrary, it is very difficult to treat with chemotherapy extensively irradiated patients.
abstract_ja: 進行セミノーマ31例に対してシスプラチン併用化学療法を施行した（精巣の病期III または大きな病期II が26例、播種性性腺外が5例）。未治療の19例中17例(89%)、腹部照射のみを受けた5例中4例(80%)が持続完全寛解(CR)に至ったが、広範な横隔膜上下への放射線療法を受けた7例中2例(28%)のみであった。病期による有意な影響は認められず、HCG値および組織学的亜群によっても結果は有意に影響されなかった。一方、LDH値が500 mIU/mlを超える患者は、正常またはそれ未満の値の患者（19例中89%の持続CR率）に比べて成績が不良であった（12例中50%の持続CR率）。中央値34か月（範囲12+〜77+か月）の追跡後、23例(74.5%)が持続CRで生存しており、2例(6%)がCR中に死亡し、さらに1例(3%)は残存病変に対する待機治療後にCRに至った。5例(16%)が癌で死亡した。毒性は、広範に照射を受けた患者では重篤であったが、未治療の患者および横隔膜下放射線療法のみを受けた患者では許容範囲内であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法は、進行セミノーマの一次治療として安全かつ効果的に用いることができる。また、横隔膜下照射のみを受けた患者にとって優れた救済療法でもある。一方、広範に照射を受けた患者を化学療法で治療することは非常に困難である。
